label: Candidate recall@10
definition: Relevant canonical identity appears in the top ten candidates
formula: relevant matches in top 10 / all relevant matches

label: Critical-conflict recall
definition: Critical attribute conflicts detected before approval

label: Unsafe merge rate
definition: Approved merges later found technically incompatible
formula: unsafe approved merges / audited approved merges
status: guardrail target: zero in critical sample

label: Abstention quality
definition: Insufficient-evidence cases correctly held for review

label: Duplicate creation prevention
definition: New requests blocked because an approved identity already exists
formula: confirmed duplicate requests blocked / all new requests

label: Approved-material search time
definition: Time to find an approved material identity

label: Legacy mapping coverage
definition: Eligible legacy records linked to a governed identity
formula: mapped legacy records / eligible legacy records

label: Critical-field completeness
definition: Eligible records with required technical fields populated
formula: records with required fields / eligible records

label: Model and data drift
definition: Change in score, missingness, and conflict distributions
